nodes.name: The Submerged Passage
nodes.summary: Flooded tidal cave in the Act 1 Mud Flats, behind the glyph wall. It is drained when the three Karui glyphs are fitted into the wall.

sources.locator: Quest objective 'open the Submerged Passage'; 'The Submerged Passage is now open'

nodes.name: The Wetlands (Act 2)
nodes.summary: Act 2 wetland area where the great tree Lorrata has rooted itself across the entrance to the Vaal Ruins. The Exile poisons the tree with Maligaro's Spike and the Baleful Gem.

sources.locator: Quest objective 'Poison the tree, Lorrata, in The Wetlands'

nodes.name: The Sewers
nodes.summary: Filthy tunnels under the river between Sarn's districts, filled with the Undying. An Undying Blockade bars the way and is burned away with Infernal Talc.

sources.locator: Walkthrough: 'Approach the Undying Blockade in The Sewers'

nodes.name: The Battlefront
nodes.summary: Sarn battlefront held by the Ebony Legion. A Blackguard chest here holds the Ribbon Spool, guarded by an optional boss.

sources.locator: Walkthrough: 'Find the Ribbon Spool in the Battlefront'

nodes.name: The Aqueduct
nodes.summary: Act 4 area on the way to Highgate, where Lady Dialla first waits for the Exile to ask them to destroy the Beast.

sources.locator: Walkthrough quest log: 'Dialla is waiting for you on the Aqueduct'

edges.description: High Templar Dominus orders the criminals of Oriath exiled to Wraeclast.

sources.locator: section 'The Present'

edges.description: The Templar theocracy of Oriath carries out the sentence of exile.

sources.locator: section 'Lore'

edges.description: The sentencing takes place in Oriath, before the exiles are shipped to Wraeclast.

sources.locator: section 'Oriath'

edges.description: A Dying Exile on the Twilight Strand describes the two dozen exiles dumped from the ship and points the Exile towards the smoke.

sources.locator: Walkthrough: Dying Exile quote "We're all that made it? They dumped... two dozen of us exiles off that ship"

edges.description: Dominus's Blackguards are the ones who dumped the exiles into the water.

sources.locator: Walkthrough: Tarkleigh quote "[Dominus's] Blackguards dumped us in the water out there"

edges.description: Hillock, the Blacksmith, is the boss the Exile kills outside Lioneye's Watch.

sources.locator: Quest infobox boss=Hillock; objective 'Kill Hillock. He is outside the town.'

edges.description: Tarkleigh gives the Exile the reward for killing Hillock.

sources.locator: Quest infobox completion=Talk to Tarkleigh; Walkthrough 'Talk to Tarkleigh for your reward'

edges.description: The Dying Exile on the beach sends the Exile up the beach, where the quest begins.

sources.locator: Walkthrough: '(Optional) Talk to the nearby Dying Exile ... there may be people further up the beach'

edges.description: The three glyphs are fitted into the glyph wall in the Mud Flats, opening the Submerged Passage.

sources.locator: Quest infobox objective 'open the Submerged Passage'; Walkthrough 'The Submerged Passage is now open'

edges.description: Tarkleigh identifies the Karui glyph shells and tells the Exile where to fit them.

sources.locator: Walkthrough: Tarkleigh dialogue 'complete the set, fit them into the sockets, and stand well back'

edges.description: Brutus, Warden of Axiom Prison, is the boss fought in the Warden's Chambers.

sources.locator: Quest infobox boss=Brutus, Lord Incarcerator; objective 'Kill Brutus in the Warden's Chambers'

edges.description: Tarkleigh starts the quest and briefs the Exile on Brutus.

sources.locator: Quest infobox start=Talk to Tarkleigh; Walkthrough Tarkleigh dialogue

edges.description: Nessa tells the Exile the history of Brutus as Warden of Axiom Prison.

sources.locator: Walkthrough: Nessa dialogue 'The tale of Brutus was a popular one in the schools of Theopolis'

edges.description: The Caged Brute is fought in the Warden's Chambers of Axiom Prison.

sources.locator: Objective: 'Kill Brutus in the Warden's Chambers in the Upper Prison'

edges.description: Merveil, the Siren, is the boss the Exile kills in her lair.

sources.locator: Quest infobox boss=Merveil, the Siren; objective 'Kill Merveil, in her lair'

edges.description: Nessa starts the quest and warns the Exile about Merveil.

sources.locator: Quest infobox start=Talk to Nessa

edges.description: The fight with Merveil takes place in her lair at the head of Siren's Cove.

sources.locator: Objective 'Kill Merveil, in her lair'; completion 'Enter the Forest' from her lair

edges.description: The Exile arrives at the Forest Encampment, the village in the Southern Forest.

sources.locator: Act 2 walkthrough: The Forest Encampment is the town of Act 2

edges.description: Greust, the Forest Encampment's weapon and armour vendor, is present in the village; he is the quest giver of Intruders in Black. The 'leader' wording was not supported by the cited page.

sources.locator: Walkthrough: Greust dialogue 'Nothing like this... Bring back the light' (Greust leads the encampment)

edges.description: Silk is one of the Forest Encampment villagers, and gives out the Sharp and Cruel quest.

sources.locator: Walkthrough intro: quest 'given by Silk in Forest Encampment'

edges.description: Yeena, a Forest Encampment resident, dreams of the shadow and is the quest source.

sources.locator: Quest walkthrough: 'talk to Yeena in the Forest Encampment to receive this quest'

edges.description: Eramir, a Forest Encampment resident, gives the Exile the bandit contract and its reward.

sources.locator: Quest infobox start=Talk to Eramir; Quest text 'Eramir and the Forest Encampment'

edges.description: Greust sends the Exile east to investigate the warriors in black.

sources.locator: Quest infobox start=Talk to Greust; Walkthrough Greust dialogue 'Go east and find these warriors in black'

edges.description: Fidelitas, the Mourning, is the boss the Exile kills in the Chamber of Sins.

sources.locator: Quest infobox boss=Fidelitas, the Mourning; objective 'Kill Fidelitas'

edges.description: Helena is the girl the Exile rescues from Fidelitas and then brings into the encampment.

sources.locator: Walkthrough: Helena dialogue 'Help me!' and 'Meet Helena in town'

edges.description: Greust's quest describes the warriors in black as Blackguards searching the Chamber of Sins. The page's Trivia says Act 2 Blackguards actually appear in the Western Forest, so the link is only medium confidence.

sources.locator: Walkthrough: Helena dialogue 'My days with the Ebony Legion are done!'

edges.description: The Blackguards are investigated and fought inside the Chamber of Sins.

sources.locator: Objective: 'Investigate the Blackguards in the Chamber of Sins'

edges.description: Silk asks the Exile to retrieve his spear from the Weaver and rewards the Exile for it.

sources.locator: Quest infobox start=Talk to Silk; Walkthrough Silk dialogue 'my best spear still in mother's eye'

edges.description: The Weaver, a giant spider, is killed to recover Maligaro's Spike.

sources.locator: Quest infobox boss=The Weaver; objective 'Kill The Weaver'

edges.description: The Weaver is killed in the Weaver's Chambers, reached from the Western Forest.

sources.locator: Walkthrough: 'venture into The Weaver's Chambers (entrance located in The Western Forest)'

edges.description: The quest is started and resolved in the Forest Encampment, where Silk lives.

sources.locator: Walkthrough: quest given by Silk in Forest Encampment; reward on return 'Talk to Silk'

sources.locator: Quest infobox boss1=Kraityn

sources.locator: Quest infobox boss2=Alira

sources.locator: Quest infobox boss3=Oak

sources.locator: Quest infobox start=Talk to Eramir; reward table 'Eramir'

edges.description: The three bandit lords (Alira, Oak, Kraityn) are the Bandit Lords faction.

sources.locator: Lead paragraph and 'Bandit choices' section

edges.description: The bandit lords terrorise the Forest Encampment, and the choice is made there.

sources.locator: Lead: bandit leaders 'terrorizing The Forest Encampment'

edges.description: Helena gives the Exile the poison plan to open the Vaal Ruins before Piety.

sources.locator: Quest infobox start='Talk to Helena in Forest Encampment'; Walkthrough Helena dialogue

sources.locator: Quest infobox start=Talk to Yeena; Walkthrough Yeena dialogue 'I dreamed this'

sources.locator: Quest walkthrough: Eramir dialogue 'you’ve caused this. Now we all suffer your consequences'

sources.locator: Walkthrough: 'Once you touch the Ancient Seal in the Vaal Ruins, you will initiate this quest'

sources.locator: Quest infobox completion='Delivered the Eye of Desire to Lady Dialla'

sources.locator: Quest infobox boss3=Doedre Darktongue

edges.description: The Corpus Malachus page gives no location. Per the Eternal Nightmare page the organ task is done in The Harvest, and Piety says Malachai sits in the Beast's Black Core, so the Beast is the closest existing node. The Harvest is not a separate node yet.

sources.locator: Quote (Piety): 'Venture deeper ... You find me those organs and I'll get us into the Black Core'

sources.locator: Quest infobox boss=Malachai, The Nightmare; objective 'Kill Malachai'

edges.description: Piety helps the Exile break Malachai's shield and is turned into an Abomination during the fight.

sources.locator: Fight description: 'Piety helps the player by disabling his shield'; transforms into 'Piety, the Abomination'

edges.description: Malachai is fought in the Beast's Black Core.

sources.locator: Quote: 'Malachai is in the Beast's black core right now'

sources.locator: Walkthrough: 'the boss of this area, Overseer Krow, has to be killed'

edges.description: Lani leads the rebel encampment at Overseer's Tower and rewards the Exile.

sources.locator: Quest completion: 'reached the rebel encampment at Overseer's Tower. Talk to Lani for a reward'

sources.locator: Walkthrough: 'enter The Ascent ... use the machine to open a portal to Oriath'

sources.locator: Walkthrough: 'arrive at the Slave Pens'

edges.description: The rebel camp at Overseer's Tower is the goal of the Slave Pens maze.

sources.locator: Quest completion: 'Enter the Overseer's Tower and talk to Lani'

sources.locator: Quest log quote: 'help the rebellion and kill Justicar Casticus ... in the Control Blocks'

edges.description: Casticus is killed in the Control Blocks.

sources.locator: Walkthrough: 'go straight to The Control Blocks and kill the boss'

edges.description: The quest is granted in Overseer's Tower and the entrance to the Control Blocks is there.

sources.locator: Walkthrough: 'This quest is granted by an NPC in the Overseer's Tower'

sources.locator: Quest log quote: 'slay High Templar Avarius ... in the Chamber of Innocence'

sources.locator: Quest log quote: 'in the Chamber of Innocence'

edges.description: The Templar Courts must be entered with Casticus's Eyes before Avarius is reached.

sources.locator: Quest log quote: 'gain access to the Templar Courts and from there, slay Avarius'

sources.locator: Walkthrough Bannon dialogue: 'Please, find Utula and stop him'

sources.locator: Walkthrough: 'Kitava has awakened and is destroying Oriath ... to defeat Kitava'

sources.locator: Quest walkthrough: 'Captain Lilly Roth ... we sail... for Wraeclast'
